categories.main_business_segments: Advance Create operates five main business segments: insurance agency (life and non-life insurance sales and consulting), ASP (cloud-based insurance industry platforms), media (insurance comparison and information site 'Hoken Ichiba'), media rep (insurance-focused digital advertising agency), and reinsurance (via its Hawaii-based subsidiary). The insurance agency business is the core, with ASP, media, and reinsurance providing synergistic support and diversification.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary digital platforms such as the Advance Create Cloud Platform (ACP), which includes customer management, application processing, and online consultation tools. It has developed the 'Dynamic OMO' online consultation system, integrates avatar and AI technologies for customer interaction and sales training, and emphasizes paperless, DX-driven insurance processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are individual retail consumers seeking life and non-life insurance, as well as insurance companies and partner agencies utilizing the company's platforms and media. Major end markets are the Japanese insurance retail sector, with some B2B services for insurance companies and agencies.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in Japan, with a network of direct branches in major urban centers and a strong online presence. The reinsurance business is conducted through a wholly owned subsidiary in Hawaii, USA, but the vast majority of revenue and assets are Japan-based.
categories.supply_chain_position: Advance Create is positioned downstream in the insurance value chain as an intermediary (agency/broker) between insurance companies and end customers. Through its ASP and reinsurance businesses, it also provides midstream services to insurance companies and agencies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include furthering digital transformation (DX) of insurance sales and administration, expanding the OMO (online merges with offline) model, enhancing AI and avatar-based customer engagement, and strengthening compliance and internal controls. The company is focused on platform expansion, operational efficiency, and leveraging technology for both customer experience and internal productivity.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily from insurance agency commissions (initial and recurring), bonuses from insurance companies, marketing and advertising fees, subscription and licensing fees for cloud-based platforms (ASP), media advertising sales, and reinsurance premiums. The ASP segment operates on a subscription (stock income) model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other large insurance agencies, online insurance comparison sites, and digital-first insurance brokers. The company faces competition from both traditional face-to-face agencies and digital/telemarketing players. Advance Create positions itself as a digital innovator and platform leader in the Japanese insurance distribution market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated sales were ¥6.6 billion, with a net loss of ¥1.54 billion, marking the fourth consecutive year of net losses. The company recently resolved a period of negative equity through a major capital increase, but continues to face financial challenges, including negative operating cash flow and ongoing restructuring. Employee count at year-end was 229.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Advance Create emphasizes a seamless, convenient insurance purchasing experience through digital innovation, combining online and offline channels (OMO), and proprietary technology such as AI-driven avatars and online consultation systems. Its unique value lies in its integrated insurance platform, broad product lineup, and ability to serve both consumers and industry partners with advanced digital tools.
